headline: Partial refunds can overpay customers or be sent twice, so this should not ship yet.
what_changed: Support staff can now enter a refund amount or leave it empty to refund the remaining balance.
The refund screen uses shorter labels and clearer customer-facing timing.
Refund records now show the dollar amount in staff logs.
The README now says that partial refunds are supported.

risks.title: Refunds can exceed the remaining balance
risks.explanation: The new partial-refund path sends any entered amount without checking it is positive or no more than the unpaid refund balance. A staff member can enter more than remains, including after an earlier partial refund. This can overpay a customer if the payment service accepts the request. Check the amount before sending it, and reject amounts above the remaining balance.

risks.title: A retry can send a second refund
risks.explanation: Each refund attempt now gets a new unique label based on the current time. If the payment succeeds but saving the order fails, a retry looks like a new request. For a partial refund, the payment service can then send the same refund again, while the order may record only one. Keep one stable protection label for a given refund attempt and save a durable refund record.

good_news: The customer-facing refund timing now says business days, which is clearer.
The change is limited to refunds, wording, and documentation.
